title: Nashville-based Singer-Songwriter Sam Tinnesz Unveils New Single "Prozac Perfect"
htmlContent:
Sam Tinnesz, the Nashville-based singer-songwriter, has just released his latest single, "Prozac Perfect," which showcases his unique blend of electronic programming, organic instruments, and contemporary melodies. "Prozac Perfect" follows in the footsteps of his debut LP, Babel, which features dark, driving production from heavy hitters like Jeremy Lutito, Josh Hawkins, Robert Marvin, and Matthew Bronleewe. 

"Prozac Perfect" is a testament to Tinnesz's growth as an artist as he continues to evolve his aggressive pop sound. The single's lyrics explore the idea of perfectionism and how it can take a toll on a person's mental health. Tinnesz's passionate vocals, paired with a pulsating beat, make for an exhilarating listening experience.

Sam Tinnesz is no newcomer to the music industry. He's a seasoned professional who has honed his craft for over a dozen years. "Prozac Perfect" is the latest example of his ability to create powerfully moving music that resonates with listeners. With his new single, Tinnesz proves once again that he is a force to be reckoned with in the music industry.

Stream "Prozac Perfect" on Spotify
